missing_evidence: Purchase order document PO-1005 (explicitly referenced by both INV-1005 and REC-1005) was never supplied
notes: All four supplied documents (invoice, bank statement, ledger entry, receipt) share matching vendor (GreenRoute Logistics Pvt. Ltd.), amount (INR 59,000), and consistent reference chains back to INV-1005, and the bank narration confirms NEFT settlement of that invoice. However, PO-1005 is cited by both the invoice and the receipt as a reference but no purchase_order document itself was provided, so its existence and terms cannot be verified - this amount/vendor consistency does not substitute for the missing PO. Additionally, REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before INV-1005 (2026-07-21), an unusual sequence for a goods/services receipt preceding its invoice that warrants review though it does not by itself indicate fraud. The receipt's presence does show a receipt document was captured, but note that a successful bank settlement alone would not have been sufficient proof of receipt-based payment terms had REC-1005 been absent; here it is present, so that specific condition is evidenced. No PO-exempt vendor pattern can be inferred since only one transaction is available for this vendor.
